tests.case: rejects malformed version %s

tests.case: filters drafts both prerelease forms and downgrades with beta %s

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Stable_ignores_d.reason: The original mixed release-list matrix selects stable 2.0.0 and opted-in 5.0.0-beta.1 through manual discovery, rejecting drafts and older/equal versions.

tests.case: selects exact %s %s manual assets and ignores foreign architecture
validates exact %s native architecture metadata

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Selects_the_exac.reason: Exact Electron NSIS, AppImage and macOS DMG names replace the old ZIP/deb/tar artifact matrix. Native metadata checks all supported architectures; manual checks cover Windows/Linux/macOS x64 and arm64. This does not execute installers.

tests.case: scans later pages and replaces foreign asset URLs with the canonical release page
bounds pagination and reports an incomplete check instead of an up to date claim

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Release_selectio.reason: Manual discovery reads subsequent pages, selects the newer tag, and uses the canonical release page instead of a foreign asset URL. Ten full pages fail explicitly.

tests.case: failed checks report failure rather than up to date

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Failed_manual_ch.reason: A failed release check preserves a failure status and no restart action.

tests.case: stages checksum-verified bytes and installs only after an explicit restart command

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Background_downl.reason: Both installed NSIS/AppImage downloaders stream and verify actual fixture bytes, expose readiness without launch, and hand off only after an explicit restart and backend stop. Installer callbacks are isolated.

tests.case: recovers the backend after installer preparation failure and retains recovery guidance during checks

ApplicationUpdaterTests.FailedInstallerP.reason: Preparation failure clears the context and awaits backend recovery without handing off installation.

tests.case: never prepares an installer when backend shutdown fails
a refused shutdown reconnects without waiting for a process that never stopped
an uncertain shutdown waits again before recovery instead of starting a competing backend

ApplicationUpdaterTests.BackendShutdownF.reason: The lifecycle service owns recovery for rejected/uncertain stops; updater cannot prepare installation until shutdown and exit are confirmed.

tests.case: %s beta opt-out clears verified prerelease files and rejects that release afterward
stable rejects prereleases and every channel rejects downgrades and CI artifacts

ApplicationUpdaterTests.RemotePreference.reason: Local and remote opt-out start from a real verified 2.0.0-beta.2 cache in both NSIS and AppImage downloaders, delete the pending files, revoke restart and reject that prerelease on the next stable check. Version policy separately excludes downgrades.

tests.case: disabled automatic updates persist while manual download remains available

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Disabled_automat.reason: Preference persistence leaves explicit download available.

tests.case: unsupported installations expose browser links and never download or install

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Unsupported_inst.reason: Unsupported builds offer the official browser action and cannot stage or install.

tests.case: accepts exact Electron platform metadata and rejects legacy or foreign artifacts and missing digests

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Missing_or_inval.reason: The metadata gate requires a canonical SHA-512 and refuses legacy/foreign/wrong-architecture payloads before download.

tests.case: removes corrupt bytes and cache metadata before a successful retry

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Hash_mismatch_de.reason: Real stream checksum failure empties pending files and metadata in both downloaders; subsequent valid bytes verify and stage successfully.

tests.case: rejects a foreign redirect before making its request and removes temporary bytes
follows the official release storage redirect while still verifying bytes

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Redirect_outside.reason: The production redirect gate runs over a loopback socket adapter: a foreign location makes no second request and leaves no bytes; official GitHub release storage succeeds with checksum verification. Chromium networking and live provider behavior are separate validation limits.

tests.case: development version %s never checks or stages

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Development_buil.reason: dev and ci versions never invoke the release driver.

tests.case: awaits a paused manual check on disposal without publishing or downloading after shutdown
prevents repeated quit events until update shutdown has drained and then permits quit

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Shutdown_drains_.reason: The main-process lifetime aborts and awaits an entered check with no later renderer publication or download. The quit barrier handles repeated events and permits exit only after the owned work settles; Electron has no Avalonia dispatcher dependency.

tests.case: disabling automatic updates aborts a blocked metadata request and completes without a response
cancels a native metadata request before it returns a response

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Turning_off_auto.reason: The controller aborts the blocked check and persists opt-out without waiting for a response; the actual updater HTTP request receives cancellation and no download follows.

tests.case: cancels a partial native stream and deletes bytes before allowing retry
cancels a download and leaves retry available without accepting a late success

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Cancelling_a_par.reason: Both real downloader paths create a partial file, receive cancellation, empty their pending cache and permit a verified retry. The controller preserves download availability and refuses late completion.

tests.case: keeps the application open and permits redownload when handoff fails
clears staging after a failed installer handoff and leaves the app open
rechecks staged bytes before installer handoff and discards a changed payload

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Failed_handoff_k.reason: The main controller recovers backend state after failed handoff and leaves retry available; the native spawn test confirms quit is not called on launch failure.

tests.case: removes corrupt bytes and cache metadata before a successful retry
does not restart when download verification fails and allows a retry

ApplicationUpdaterTests.Archive_staging_.reason: Electron stages checksum-verified installer/AppImage files rather than extracting Avalonia archives. Failure in that staging path removes actual bytes, refuses restart and permits retry in both downloader variants.
